title: Chapter 330
text:
Daily hires were the lowest level of missions. Once the credit points reached a certain level, low-level missions would no longer increase credit points. This classification system was easy to understand. It was convenient for employers to directly understand the abilities of mercenaries and ensure that they could hire a suitable team. ()

120 points happened to be the first standard. This was the first threshold to select a mercenary group. Only after reaching 120 points could a mercenary group be considered a "proper" mercenary group, and more employment applications would be opened.

The efficiency of professional players was very high. Two days later, the mercenary group had accumulated 120 credit points. Han Xiao released the faction quest reward. The top three credit points were King Admiral, Hao Tian, and the captain of the Fanatics Squad, Yan Ran. Other than the Four Big Families, Han Xiao also recruited the top ranked clubs in the league, such as Thunder Storm, Fanatics, and so on. Torrential Rain was still alright. They had a beauty like Rainy Kim, so there was quite a lot of attention on them. Compared to them, Fanatics was even more pathetic. They were also a first-tier club, but their presence was extremely weak. To be honest, if Yan Ran hadn't been ranked third in terms of contribution this time, Han Technician would have almost forgotten about her existence …

Han Xiao gave out extra rewards to the three of them. At the same time, he used a provocative tone to say that the mercenary group would definitely reward them for their contributions. The additional reward was the Sin-A Carbon-Based Creature Detector (Helmet) that he had just created. It required 800 Faction Contribution Points to exchange for it. He gave it to the three of them as if he had earned 800 Faction Contribution Points for free. This immediately attracted the envy of the other players.

At this time, Han Xiao said, "This detection helmet can greatly improve one's field of vision and adapt to a variety of harsh environments …" He introduced the functions, implying that this was a must-have equipment for outstation missions, and recommended that everyone exchange for it. (Author's note: UU novel is the latest update)

The three of them tried out the functions of the helmet. The built-in screen displayed all sorts of environmental analysis, energy analysis, and so on. It could also be adjusted. The function of the helmet was clear at a glance. It also had the function of protecting the head. It was suitable for equipment of all professions.

Mad Blade was close to Hao Tian, so he borrowed it for a while. He nodded and said, "It's really good stuff."

When the others saw this, they followed suit. The three helmets were passed around, and everyone experienced the functions. They deeply felt that the functions were very practical, and they all had thoughts of exchanging for them.

The first elder reward and the faction mission reward, all the players … er, most of the players had accumulated 600 faction contribution points. They were only 200 points away from exchanging for the helmet. They were itching to get it.

Han Xiao had deliberately set the price at 800 Contribution Points to give the players the impression that they only needed a little bit of Contribution Points to get the prize. Apart from completing quests, the other way to earn Contribution Points was obvious, and that was to sacrifice items and money!

It seemed like he was giving away 600 contribution points to all … most of the players, but in reality, this was bait to lure players to spend money. It was a very common promotion model. Han Xiao implemented the method of giving value to the Favorability Points. This time, he was giving actual value to the faction relationship. Not only were his items high quality and cheap, but he also had the promotion effect of the faction relationship. He could guarantee that players would have the highest priority to spend on him. ()

The exchange rate that he had temporarily set was: within the Indifferent to Friendly range (0 – 1,000 Contribution Points), 50 Enas could be exchanged for 100 Faction Relationship points. Therefore, to the players, the helmet was worth 400 Enas, and they only needed to 'spend' 25% of the original price to get it. It was only 100 Enas, which was a great deal.

Half of the players had obtained 1,500 Enas from the Short Horn Star mission, so they were very rich and easily exchanged for the helmet. The other half of the players had been doing daily missions for a few days, but the rewards were very little. However, they were very cunning and directly borrowed money from the other half of the players.

"We're all the best in the industry, and we see each other all the time. It's only 100 Enas. Aren't you embarrassed to not lend it to us?"

"Not lending? You're looking down on me! "

"Aiya, we're all brothers. We'll definitely earn money in the future. You don't have to worry about us not paying you back. You can run away, but the temple can't. Lend me the money, and I'll owe you one."

After a series of chaos, these players finally exchanged for the helmet in the form of debt.

Of course, the people from the Temple of God owed the most, so Li Ge was very upset.

More than fifty customers, a small profit, but a quick turnover. More than 6,000 Enas entered his account, and Han Technician's savings were replenished. He was very satisfied.

The raw materials for this batch of helmets were materials brought up from Blue Star. The cost was extremely low, and the profit margin was unbelievable.

…

Everyone came to the Mercenary Hall. Han Xiao was about to open the mercenary interface and accept the Sunil mission when he suddenly realized that the Mercenary Hall was a little strange today. A group of mercenaries was squeezed in a corner of the hall, and it was very noisy.

Han Xiaoxin was curious, so he walked over and saw a short blue-skinned man in the middle of the crowd. He was wearing a loose and luxurious robe, and his hair was like steel nails. His ears were pointy, and he did not have a nose. He had two pairs of eyes that were narrowed into slits, and his lips were curved downwards like half-moons. This race was called the Blue Man, and he looked very much like a certain expression.

The Blue Man gave the other races the impression that they were stingy, stingy, and opportunistic. This Blue Man was from a resource exploration team funded by a certain financial group. He was recruiting mercenaries offline in the Mercenary Hall to avoid the small service fee that the Mercenary Alliance had to pay.

This Blue Man was called Martin, and he was introducing the job requirements. "I'm from a resource exploration team, and I'm going to Planet Gardon-791 for a three-day field exploration. I want to recruit a group of bodyguards, and each of them will be paid 400 Enas. They will be responsible for protecting the exploration team, clearing the surface beasts, and exploring dangerous areas. They need to have at least 120 Credibility Points …"

The mercenaries around had cold expressions on their faces. The pay for this job was not very high, and it was not going through the Mercenary Alliance's channels. It was like taking a 'private' job, and it would not be recorded in the resume. They would not be able to increase their Credibility Points, so it was not very attractive to them. They all watched from the side, and no one came forward to recruit.

Han Xiao's eyes flashed. He looked at the star map and said, "Planet Gardon-791 is near the Sunil base. I can earn some extra money on this trip. Although it's only 400 Enas, I have more than fifty people in my team. Many a little makes a mickle, so it's quite a sum."

Some barren planets without life had the name of a star system and a serial number. It was convenient to locate them, and they were basically only used to collect resources.

Han Xiao squeezed through the crowd, walked forward, and said, "Black Star Mercenary, more than fifty people. Only group employment for now."

"Let me see your Credibility Points." Martin sized up Han Xiao and was a little happy. He had been shouting for so long that his voice was hoarse. Finally, someone wanted to recruit him.

Han Xiao brought up the mercenary group interface and sent it to Martin.

Martin was overjoyed when he saw that his Credibility Points had met the requirement. He was about to agree, but when he looked down, his expression changed. He said in surprise, "You guys have never accepted combat employment before?"

The Black Star Mercenary's resume showed dozens of daily jobs in the hub. Most of them were cleaning missions. Normal mercenaries would not even bother to do this kind of work. It was almost no different from manual labor.
